meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行快速开发、渲染和发布超帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在本地或云端构建和渲染超帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Develop, render, and publish hyperframe animations from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build and render hyperframe animations locally or in the cloud

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以运行 HyperFrames CLI 命令来创建、编辑、预览和渲染视频项目。它会执行代码检查、生成快照、比较版本，并支持本地或云端渲染。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建或编辑视频项目、诊断构建或渲染失败、或需要预览和渲染视频时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperframes 初始化一个新项目，名为 myvideo。
say.note: Claude 会运行 init 命令创建项目骨架。

say.text: 运行 lint 检查当前项目的 HTML 和结构。
say.note: Claude 会执行 lint 命令并报告问题。

say.text: 用 draft 质量渲染项目，输出到 out.mp4。
say.note: Claude 会执行 render 命令并生成视频文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run HyperFrames CLI commands to scaffold, edit, preview, and render video projects. It performs linting, snapshot generation, version comparison, and supports local or cloud rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or edit a video project, diagnose build or render failures, or preview and render videos.

say_en.text: Initialize a new hyperframes project named myvideo.
say_en.note: Claude runs the init command to scaffold the project.

say_en.text: Run lint on the current project.
say_en.note: Claude executes lint and reports issues.

say_en.text: Render the project with draft quality to out.mp4.
say_en.note: Claude runs render and produces the video file.
